'''2007 Worlds Team JW Millet LS Yavin Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[JW Millet]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[JW Millet]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Team
